notes.title: RIFTSTORM Alpha Playtest is Now LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792726/f415bc64d26eb01ebdad89746acacec77f5354a5.png[/img]

The wait is over, our RIFTSTORM Alpha Playtest is now live, and you can try the game for free from [b] 16 - 30 October, 2024 (PT).[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3212570/RIFTSTORM_Alpha_Demo

After two playtests and two years in production, RIFTSTORM is now officially in Alpha, and we owe a massive thanks to all of you who have been testing the game with us. 

[h3]Peer into the Darkness[/h3]
This Alpha version of the game aims to address one of your biggest concerns from our previous playtests: thematic immersion. A lot of you loved our game, but didn't quite get what your role is in our world or what the Mythic Protocol is. This time around, we've reworked our tutorial system to throw players into the deep dark underbelly of the secretive organization. 

[h3]New environments, new weapons, new systems[/h3]
We've also implemented our overhauled Dungeon System 2.0, that allows for greater map design flexibility and more interactive actions in our maps, alongside our updated Loot and Crafting systems in the game. Based on your feedback, we've expanded the armory inventory and provided universal access to it across all characters. We hope that these changes help to improve the loot grind and allow you to refine your builds with your idea weapons for each character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792726/e8c29567ff1380ca9e3ac7f611bf3fdeb91b72f3.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792726/6ce71d714514c2ad93f10c22a512fabba023dd01.gif[/img]

[h3]Get competitive[/h3]
By popular demand, [b]leaderboards[/b] are also back in this playtest though we are focusing the challenges a bit more this time around. If you're the competitive type, we will be hosting timed-runs for the leaderboard and endurance runs for the Challenge Tower.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792726/9a7db107e1f87404c63532aa3ec2fe22ec60ee32.gif[/img]

Each floor you conquer in the Challenge Tower brings you closer to the top, unlocking exclusive in-game items and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792726/108be8714f113cf78899980c3141b2052d48ba0e.png[/img]

Daily standings will be shared on our website and across our social channels. Be sure to check out where you stand one our [url=https://www.playriftstorm.com/leaderboard]leaderboard page. [/url]

We hope you will have a great time with this build, and if you want to stay up to date with the latest news, media, and other announements please follow us on across our social channels.

==============================================================================

We can’t wait for you to play RIFTSTORM and experience all the new features we’ve prepared for you. Make sure to download the demo today to experience RIFTSTORM. 

Enjoy the playtest and good luck to tackling the missions🫡


Warmly,
Fayi and The RIFTSTORM team

notes.title: RIFTSTORM Alpha Playtest Countdown
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Fayi here, and I’m super excited that our Alpha Playtest starts tomorrow🥳 Are you ready to play [b]RIFTSTORM for FREE for 2 weeks?[/b] Because I sure am!  

Currently, the RIFTSTORM team is putting the finishing touches on preparations for tomorrow’s Alpha Playtest. We’re excited to make sure everything goes perfectly so you can fully enjoy playing RIFTSTORM. Also, I want to let you know that our [b]Alpha Demo page is now LIVE.[/b] Don't forget to check out the details there. 

In preparation for our playtest, I want to let you know that RIFTSTORM is just the tip of the iceberg in our sprawling Occultical universe. Set within this vast world, RIFTSTORM connects to Confiction Labs' growing ecosystem of games, media, and more. To access exclusive media, rewards, and other products within our ecosystem, we invite you to join our [url=https://one.confiction.com/portal]Portal.[/url]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792726/2272e720babcdd24471c3937f04a6fbda2432922.png[/img]

[h2]What is a Portal? [/h2]

The Portal is where community members, fans, and players can delve into the world of Occultical and Collaborative Entertainment. Designed as a nexus for media, content, and exclusive rewards, the Portal invites all users to become a part of the Mythic Protocol. 

During this Alpha Playtest, you’ll have the chance to get exclusive skins and more rewards just by playing RIFTSTORM and completing the playtest mission arc. Available only to early participants [b](only last from 16 October to 30 October PT). [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792726/146b36d74dd713b4f0c987fcfb2ee03d79e6493a.png[/img]

You’ll collect Protocol Points by finishing assignments in-game which can be claimed through the assignment's dashboard. These points act as a valuable currency within the Confiction Labs ecosystem, providing players with the ability to unlock and redeem future rewards. 

[h2]What are the protocol points? [/h2]

Protocol points refer to the points given to the users in our Portal for completing quests. These protocol points can later be redeemed for future rewards (i.e. exclusive alternative Weaver skins, access to new media, in-game rewards, and more). Protocol Points are accumulated through the completion of in-game and ecosystem-related assignments. 

Collect your protocol points and don’t miss your chance to be among the first to play. Be sure to [url=https://confiction.link/getalphademo]download the demo[/url] from [b]16 October to 30 October PT.[/b]

==============================================================================

Alright, that’s it from me now. Get some rest, and see you tomorrow in the playtest! I’ll catch you in-game 😆 


Warmly,
Fayi

notes.title: Play RIFTSTORM for Free for 2 Weeks
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone![/h2]

Get ready to play RIFTSTORM for free for two weeks! Our team is thrilled to announce that our Alpha Playtest will be going live on [b]October 16, 7 PM PT until October 30, 7 PM PT.[/b] For those of you who have been with us since our Pre-Alpha builds, this playtest will be incorporating a few big updates to RIFTSTORM – some visible, some under-the-hood, but all of it is thanks to playtesters like you. 


[h1]What’s New? [/h1]

[h2]2 New Weavers[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792726/117d7b1aea39515161678bb394d5aed9f7763ec5.png[/img]
[h3][b]Rook[/b][/h3]
A fresh recruit kitted out with all tools of the Mythic Protocol trade, Rook is sassy to use, and powerful in the right hands. She is your combat all-rounder, armed with grenades, mines, and a single-target stun spell.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792726/69e41798037b42351edcc5b73c16bbf1912ef84f.png[/img]
[h3][b]Thistle[/b][/h3]
A thief, a collector, and a Weaver all in one, Thistle carries mysterious occult tome with her into battle. Armed with powerful spells that can wipe out entire cohorts of mythics, Thistle is spell-casting powerhouse that requires precision timing and control to master. 


[h2]Reworked Dungeon Systems[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792726/dc8d9fabeaa8a313321e768fc54510b3fe4c1100.jpg[/img]

Our long-awaited Dungeon System Upgrade brings some graphical updates and mission variety to RIFTSTORM. Experience new larger maps across our sprawling Keystone missions, immerse yourself into the eerie world of the Occultical with our new biomes and lighting systems, and experience the new narrative arc with more agency and immersion than before. 
 

[h2]Loot and Weapon Updates[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792726/281b352bf4c5b8a2097c56939407af085f2b741c.jpg[/img]

New weapons are added to the roster as we roll out our much-requested crafting update. All weapons can now be dismantled for Scrap, and Scrap will now be used to Craft new weapons at random or via the newly implemented Dataseed system. 


[h1]Accessing the Playtest[/h1]

Access to our Alpha Playtest will be granted through our Store Page once the playtest period is live, running from [b]October 16, 7 PM PT until October 30, 7 PM PT.[/b] Stay tuned for the announcement to be among the first to play. 
Also, if you haven’t wishlisted our game yet, make sure to [url=mythic.link/RUODRr]wishlist [/url]now!
================================================================================
Thanks for sticking with us through each phase of development. We are so excited for you to try these updates and see you in-games soon! 


Warmly, 

Fayi and The RIFTSTORM Team

notes.title: Riftstorm Pre-Alpha Gameplay
notes.content:
Assume control of the elite secret operatives of the Mythic Protocol secret-society and face off against cosmic horrors and supernatural threats around the world. Riftstorm is a multiplayer Roguelite Looter-Shooter set in a world of cosmic horrors and chic occultism where unique operatives, skills, weapons, and dungeons combine to create endless replayability.

[h2]Key Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*]  Intense roguelite shooter, where every encounter and incursion will be different.
[*]  Playable for up to 3 players, Riftstorm is playable both as a co-op and for solo.
[*]  Multiple missions and environments, with procedurally generated layouts.
[*]  Regardless of your skills and experience, the game is easy to understand and pick-up.
[*]  Every action matters, the collective choices and actions will affect the world-building.
[/list]

WISHLIST NOW: [url]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2282790/RIFTSTORM/[/url]

notes.title: Dev Blog #5 | Welcome to the 2nd Pre-Alpha Playtest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792726/a1a6462a60eed4975a695db11cf48e61731f2ae1.png[/img]

Hey there, welcome!  

Today marks the start of Riftstorm’s second pre-alpha playtest. Many of you have been waiting for this, maybe more than we do! 

This round of testing owes a big thanks to everyone who participated in our first playtest last year and submitted bug reports and detailed feedback. We’re bringing a few more things for you to try out this time, and we hope to hear from you all again.  

Last year, we also challenged all playtesters with what we thought would be a ridiculous number of mythics to kill in just under a week – you beat it and then some. That inspired us to act early on our promise to build Collaborative Entertainment by teasing out a small sampling of how we intend to take player action and turn that into consequential effects in our universe.  For you who haven’t seen it, make sure to check the link: https://www.mythicprotocol.com/doggy-daycare    

This time around, we’re ramping up the stakes with a new mythic and the story around it – more details below. 

Our game development team has been working hard in tweaking, changing, and adding new features for this playtest (surely for those who joined our previous playtest will notice the improvement 😉).   

On the other hand, our creative team has been throwing in some amazing artworks such as comics, the Shade as our new mythic threat, and Hertz and Spraybot as new Operatives. We’re also able to present you with cool content like the Announcement Trailer and tease content in social media. And of course, a fun ARG to crank up the hype.   

What’s new on Riftsorm upcoming playtest: https://twitter.com/playRIFTSTORM/status/1764818130285760512   

 

[b][h1]What to look out for [/h1][/b]

If you've been keeping an eye on our social media channels, you may have noticed a series of posts integrating into a "Rising Threat" campaign. Our creative team has been dropping some cool hints about our upcoming playtest, which you can view on our website: https://www.mythicprotocol.com/  

Don’t worry if you missed it, our creative chief loves making these ARGs even if they tend to skew a bit too esoteric for most people. Keep and eye for more ARGs and puzzles in the future – who knows, there might be more in there than just hints for our next event. You can still check out the threat index campaign below, and keep an eye out on the many, many, many easter eggs we’ve put in there. 

 

[b][h1]Collaborative Entertainment and You – or how you will affect our world: [/h1][/b]

Expanding on the small glimpse of Collaborative Entertainment that we teased - after many of you decided to murder 5,000,000 mythics in just a few days. This year’s stakes are much higher.   

New to this playtest is the inclusion of 3 Keystone missions. These missions not only advance your access to the global threat levels they also tell a short narrative arc of the Mythic Protocol’s efforts to contain the new threat posed by the mythics known only as the shades. As you dive into the story, know that it all culminates in what we call a Flashpoint event. An event that will irrevocably change the future of our universe directly through your action – or inaction.   

This playtest, that flashpoint event is called Operation Tombstone. We won’t give too much away right now, but suffice to say: we wish you the best of luck as you take on one of the hardest missions we’ve put out to date – and remember: your successes, or failures, matter. 

That’ll be it for now, but we wanted to end with a few notes from the team that hasn’t slept in the last couple weeks getting this test ready. 

 
[b]
[h1]Remarks from the dev team: [/h1][/b]

[quote=author][b]Fandry - Creative Director[/b]

Hello everyone!  

During this playtest, our team has been at 110% effort to address the feedback we got from previous playtest, and even added new things to enjoy. Highlights including early version of coop lobby (that are much requested on our last playtest), a new summoning-oriented character “Spraybot”, new enemies, new weapon loot (that have unique mechanics waiting for you to, uh, exploit i guess), early test for story missions, and more.  

Current challenge tower (Site-19), along with a new Ultimate Showdown (Op. Tombstone at Georgia), is actually challenging. We’ve been yelling in panic at the dev room trying to clear them after work hours, so we’d love to see you try too.  

All in all, though a lot of them need time to implement, your feedback have been really helpful for us. Please enjoy the playtest, complain to us, and let’s build RIFTSTORM together!  

  

[b]Valent - Head Producer[/b]

Hey there, Playtest 1 veterans and fresh recruits!  

Guess what? It’s that time again—playtest o’clock! We’ve been digging through your feedback from the first round. And I’m very glad that our team has successfully added some of it. As Fandry mentioned, we do have a Lobby List, so you could play coop easier. Added some solo missions to grind and also story missions! And lastly please welcome our new good boy “Spraybot”  and Daddy “Hertz”!   

I’m very nervous and excited at the same time for this playtest. I do hope you guys can have fun finding some OP or weird combination with our weapons and lythons!   

*cough* Siphon Shot *cough*   

Yes, despite tons of sweat and a few all-nighters to make this happen, Rifstorm is still far from perfection. So don't hold back on the critiques, suggestions, and bug reports – we're counting on you to help us shape this game into something even better.   

That’s all from me, thank you for being here and let’s play the game!   

 P.S.: For veterans, if you're missing Steve, he's hanging out in Site-19, feeling a bit lonely. Pay him a visit, won't you?  

 
[b]Made - Lead Artist
[/b]
Hi Hi Hi,  

Welcome to our newest playtest ~  

This is our latest iteration for Riftstorm based on previous playtest  

We happily present you,  

Two our new operatives to check "Hertz" and "Spraybot"  

All new weapon~   

New Enemies 'Shade' ^ ^  

New Hidden Feature, A lot of fixes, and some new bug - maybe old bugs too T T - I hope you don't encounter them  

Little buff and nerf (esp to dev's favorite lythons corrosive aura :) )  

And new challenging mission for you to clear  

Enjoy the playtest, play with your friends,  

It will be helpful and excited to hear all your feedback  

Cheers <3 [/quote]


[h3]Playtest period: March 8, 2024 – March 15, 2024
Hope you enjoy the playtest!  [/h3]

 

Thank you and catch you later 👻  

Regards,  

Mongki

notes.title: 2nd Pre-Alpha Playtest Coming in March 8, 2024!
notes.content:
[i]We were hoping some of you might uncover this date on your own, but maybe our creative team made the little [b]Threat Index Puzzle[/b] a little too esoteric to solve. Anyway, that doesn’t affect how excited to announce our next playtest and the additions to our media.  [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792726/cec3085de1b2781ad3ee443f4feec9a4855c2f9c.png[/img]
In case you didn’t get a chance to play during our November playtest or see the follow-on content associated with it, you can catch up here: [url=https://www.mythicprotocol.com/doggy-daycare]mythicprotocol.com/doggy-daycare[/url]

We want to take another chance to say a big thank you to everyone who participated in the playtest and to everyone else who is hoping to get the chance to jump into the action.  

[h3]So what’s new? What are we testing? And where will the story unfold from here? 

[/h3]
[h2][b]New Operatives Join the Fight
[/b][/h2]

Joining Starling are two new Operative: [b]Hertz and Spraybot[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792726/bdc5d0ffdbbcc49e8dc1ecb89fa3a5a77700b2fe.jpg[/img] 

Hertz will be replacing Codename: Atlas as the shotgun-wielding tanky operative for those of you looking to get up close and personal with mythics. 

Spraybot on the other hand is a lightweight support operative that relies on turrets and positioning to keep the fighting going. 

[h2][b]A New Mythic Threat
[/b][/h2]
The keen-eyed puzzle solvers among you might have already guessed that our new Mythic threat comes from the aptly named: [b]Shade[/b]. These ghostly creatures can swarm and overwhelm even the most well-coordinated operatives, so keep an eye out. 

[h2][b]Loot? We have more.
[/b][/h2]
We’re also slowly scaling up the armory banks across the Mythic Protocol and we have 10 new weapons being added to various mission pools.  

[h2][b]Narrative Implementation & Impact
[/b][/h2]
Finally, we’re also implementing a short three-mission narrative arc that will trace and deal specifically with the new threat posed by Shades around the world. In this globe-trotting mission sequence, your actions – success or failure will irrevocably impact the world and operatives of the Mythic Protocol. 

We’ll share more details as we go, but mark your calendars, share this post, and wishlist our game to stay in the loop. 

[h2][b]Don't Forget to Request Access![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792726/511ef0d742ab79a0fee83a5e717ca628be034910.gif[/img]

Cheers, 
Riftstorm Team

notes.title: Dev Blog #2 | Why We Playtest?
notes.content:
Hi Everyone and welcome back to our second Dev Blog, by yours truly.

If you haven't already checked, we've just released our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2282790/view/6173930465534832273] first Developer Blog [/url] introducing what Riftstorm is all about.

We are so close to our first early playtest! Personally, it’s been a nerve-wracking month, but we hope all of that will be paid off once we can see people experiencing it for the first time 

[i](and for those that come to Gamescom 2023 and PAX, we’re so happy that you’re back!).
[/i]
I'm also excited to finally introduce you to the hardworking peeps behind the scenes. Working with them has been one of the most engaging experiences as someone who has been dreaming of working in a game studio. It has been a humbling experience to understand what’s happening behind the scenes especially if you’re only judging a game from a gamer/reviewer perspective.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792726/9c7fc893216cdece702c32e3db33921cc194ed26.png[/img]
[h2]How do you feel that the public playtest is finally here?
Anything that you have in mind right now?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792726/3b00626a417fe382094a0ddbd0ebef238bb76728.jpg[/img]
[h3]Fandry[/h3]
We expect the players to protest and give a lot of complaints lol. Right now we’re trying to make the gameplay as enjoyable as possible, especially the core experience. If the not polished game core gameplay is not fun, then even if we polished it further, it’s still not going to be fun.

We want you to experience the raw form of Riftstorm.

And through this playtest, our hope is to bring the game that we’ve been working on for years, to the hands of gamers all around the world.

[h2]How is the team preparing for the playtest?​[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792726/53803bbbdaac0d2fc67b9f0cee7fb8f90af8e408.jpg[/img]
[h3]Valent[/h3]
There have been lots of debates inside the team. From nerfing or buffing the monsters, weapons, and so on. Most of it circles around the team's subjective feelings about the feature and the content of our build.

Sometimes, Fandry will ask questions like, "What is the intent of this? Why does it work like that?" and that often initiates start "the debate". Of course, my role is to ensure that these debates will be fruitful, and result in something we can implement in the game. 

Personally, I always appreciate when these "debates" happen, especially when it comes to improving our playtest build.

As someone who hasn't worked on a game of this scale before, these playtests are crucial for us to move forward, and finally deliver a great top-down ARPG shooter gameplay for you guys.

[h2]Here's a video of them both on screen, as well as our other team members.​[/h2]
[previewyoutube=TDrZp2rcIzs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]So, why do we actually do the playtest?​[/h2]
As a small studio from Indonesia, reaching out to gamers all around the world has been a huge challenge for us. Besides the language barrier, it's difficult to understand what gamers want outside Indonesia if you have never been stepping into their shoes. 

[h3]Getting validation is important​[/h3]
[i]By validation, it’s as simple as we want to get it from people who actually enjoy playing games like Riftstorm. So we hope that you can enjoy playing a new game from a genre that you like while being a part of it! As someone who has participated in playtests before, having your favorite game improved based on your input makes me appreciate the game more.[/i]

[h3]We want to understand what you like and what you don't like[/h3]
[i]As early as this pre-alpha stage, it’s all about the core mechanics, and that’s what we’re trying to focus on in this playtest. 

Is it fun playing it together or alone? Is shooting monsters satisfying enough? How about the UI and UX? Why the Community Manager is missing on Discord? and so on.

(the last one is just joking, but I hear you...)

In short, how you like or don’t like the game will mean a lot for us to make Riftstorm the best version that It can be.[/i]

[h2]We want to get to know (more) of you!​[/h2]
Through this open playtest, we hope we can reach out to more people to play Riftstorm and we hope your first experience with Riftstorm is a great one!

So stay tuned to our social channels for more information on how you can become one of our pioneers for Riftstorm.

I will be on Riftstorm Discord if you have any questions so don’t hesitate to pay a visit to our Discord too!

Thank you for reading this, and see you in the next developer blog!

Cheers, 
Keeks
